# ash v3.29.3 - Table of Contents

> A declarative, extensible framework for building Elixir applications.

## Modules

- Core API
  - [Ash](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.md): The primary interface to call actions and interact with resources.

  - [Ash.ActionInput](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.ActionInput.md): Input for a custom action
  - [Ash.Changeset](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Changeset.md): Changesets are used to create and update data in Ash.
  - [Ash.Query](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Query.md): A data structure for reading data from a resource.

- Resources
  - [Ash.CodeInterface](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.CodeInterface.md): Used to define the functions of a code interface for a resource.

  - [Ash.Domain](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Domain.md): A domain allows you to interact with your resources, and holds domain-wide configuration.
  - [Ash.Notifier](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Notifier.md): A notifier is an extension that receives various events

  - [Ash.Notifier.Notification](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Notifier.Notification.md): Represents a notification that will be handled by a resource's notifiers
  - [Ash.Resource.Calculation](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Calculation.md): The behaviour for defining a module calculation, and the struct for storing a defined calculation.

  - [Ash.Resource.Calculation.Builtins](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Calculation.Builtins.md): Built in calculations that are automatically imported in the calculations section
  - [Ash.Resource.ManualCreate](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.ManualCreate.md): A module to implement manual create actions.

  - [Ash.Resource.ManualDestroy](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.ManualDestroy.md): A module to implement manual destroy actions.
  - [Ash.Resource.ManualRead](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.ManualRead.md): A module to implement manual read actions.

  - [Ash.Resource.ManualRelationship](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.ManualRelationship.md): A module to implement manual relationships.

  - [Ash.Resource.ManualUpdate](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.ManualUpdate.md): A module to implement manual update actions.

- Queries
  - [Ash.Query.Aggregate](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Query.Aggregate.md): Represents an aggregated association value
  - [Ash.Query.Calculation](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Query.Calculation.md): Represents a calculated attribute requested on a query
  - [Ash.Resource.Preparation](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Preparation.md): The behaviour for an action-specific query preparation.
  - [Ash.Resource.Preparation.Builtins](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Preparation.Builtins.md): Builtin query preparations

- Changes
  - [Ash.Resource.Change](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Change.md): The behaviour for an action-specific resource change.
  - [Ash.Resource.Change.Builtins](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Change.Builtins.md): Built in changes that are available to all resources

- Validations
  - [Ash.Resource.Validation](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Validation.md): Represents a validation in Ash.
  - [Ash.Resource.Validation.Builtins](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Validation.Builtins.md): Built in validations that are available to all resources

- Authorization
  - [Ash.Authorizer](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Authorizer.md): The interface for an ash authorizer
  - [Ash.Policy.Check](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.md): A behaviour for declaring checks, which can be used to easily construct
authorization rules.
  - [Ash.Policy.FilterCheck](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.FilterCheck.md): A type of check that is represented by a filter statement
  - [Ash.Policy.SimpleCheck](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.SimpleCheck.md): A type of check that operates only on request context, never on the data
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.Builtins](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.Builtins.md): The global authorization checks built into ash

- Extensions
  - [Ash.DataLayer.Ets](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.DataLayer.Ets.md): An ETS (Erlang Term Storage) backed Ash Datalayer, for testing and lightweight usage.
  - [Ash.DataLayer.Mnesia](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.DataLayer.Mnesia.md): An Mnesia backed Ash Datalayer.
  - [Ash.DataLayer.Simple](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.DataLayer.Simple.md): A data layer that returns structs.
  - [Ash.Notifier.PubSub](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Notifier.PubSub.md): A builtin notifier to help you publish events over any kind of pub-sub tooling.
  - [Ash.Policy.Authorizer](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Authorizer.md): An authorization extension for ash resources.
  - [Ash.Reactor](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Reactor.md): `Ash.Reactor` is a [`Reactor`](https://hex.pm/packages/reactor) extension
which provides steps for working with Ash resources and actions.
  - [Ash.Resource](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.md): A resource is a static definition of an entity in your system.

- Introspection
  - [Ash.DataLayer.Ets.Info](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.DataLayer.Ets.Info.md): Introspection helpers for the Ets data layer
  - [Ash.DataLayer.Mnesia.Info](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.DataLayer.Mnesia.Info.md): Introspection helpers for Ash.DataLayer.Mnesia
  - [Ash.Domain.Info](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Domain.Info.md): Introspection tools for Ash.Domain
  - [Ash.Notifier.PubSub.Info](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Notifier.PubSub.Info.md): Introspection helpers for Ash.Notifier.PubSub
  - [Ash.Policy.Info](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Info.md): An authorization extension for ash resources.
  - [Ash.Resource.Info](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Info.md): Introspection for resources
  - [Ash.TypedStruct.Info](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.TypedStruct.Info.md): Introspection for typed structs

- Visualizations
  - [Ash.Domain.Info.Diagram](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Domain.Info.Diagram.md): Generate Mermaid diagrams from a specified domain.
  - [Ash.Domain.Info.Livebook](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Domain.Info.Livebook.md): Generate a Livebook from a specified domain.

  - [Ash.Policy.Chart.Mermaid](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Chart.Mermaid.md): Generates policy mermaid charts

- Testing
  - [Ash.Generator](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Generator.md): Tools for generating input to Ash resource actions and for generating seed data.
  - [Ash.Seed](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Seed.md): Helpers for seeding data, useful for quickly creating lots of data either for database seeding or testing.
  - [Ash.Test](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Test.md): Testing helpers for Ash.

- Builtins
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.AccessingFrom](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.AccessingFrom.md): This check is true when the current action is being run "through" a relationship.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.Action](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.Action.md): This check is true when the action name matches the provided action name.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.ActionType](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.ActionType.md): This check is true when the action type matches the provided type
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.ActorAbsent](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.ActorAbsent.md): This check is true when the actor is `nil`, and false when the actor is specified.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.ActorAttributeEquals](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.ActorAttributeEquals.md): This check is true when the value of the specified attribute of the actor equals the specified value.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.ActorPresent](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.ActorPresent.md): This check is true when there is an actor specified, and false when the actor is `nil`.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.ChangingAttributes](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.ChangingAttributes.md): This check is true when attribute changes correspond to the provided options.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.ChangingRelationships](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.ChangingRelationships.md): This check is true when the specified relationship is changing
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.ContextEquals](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.ContextEquals.md): This check is true when the value of the specified key or path in the changeset or query context equals the specified value.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.Expression](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.Expression.md): The check module used for `expr`s in policies
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.FilteringOn](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.FilteringOn.md): This check is true when the field provided is being referenced anywhere in a filter statement.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.Loading](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.Loading.md): This check is true when the field or relationship, or path to field, is being loaded and false when it is not.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.Matches](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.Matches.md): This check is true when the specified function returns true
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.PrivateAction](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.PrivateAction.md): This check is true when the current action is private (`public?: false`).
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.RelatesToActorVia](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.RelatesToActorVia.md): This check passes if the data relates to the actor via the specified relationship or path of relationships.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.RelatingToActor](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.RelatingToActor.md): This check is true when the specified relationship is being changed to the current actor.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.Resource](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.Resource.md): This check is true when the resource matches the provided resource name or names.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.Selecting](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.Selecting.md): This check is true when the field is being selected and false when it is not.
  - [Ash.Policy.Check.Static](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Policy.Check.Static.md): This check is always the result provided
  - [Ash.Resource.Change.AtomicSet](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Change.AtomicSet.md): A change that sets an attribute using an expression evaluated in the data layer during create.
  - [Ash.Resource.Change.CascadeDestroy](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Change.CascadeDestroy.md): Cascade a resource's destroy action to a related resource's destroy action.
  - [Ash.Resource.Change.CascadeUpdate](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Change.CascadeUpdate.md): Cascade a resource's update action to a related resource's update action.
  - [Ash.Resource.Change.Context](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Change.Context.md): The context for a change.
  - [Ash.Resource.Change.GetAndLock](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Change.GetAndLock.md): Refetches the record being updated or destroyed, and locks it with the given type.

  - [Ash.Resource.Change.GetAndLockForUpdate](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Change.GetAndLockForUpdate.md): Refetches the record being updated or destroyed, and locks it for update.

  - [Ash.Resource.Change.Increment](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Change.Increment.md): Increments an attribute's value by the amount specified, which defaults to 1.

  - [Ash.Resource.Change.OptimisticLock](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Change.OptimisticLock.md): Apply an "optimistic lock" on a record being updated or destroyed.
  - [Ash.Resource.Validation.ActionIs](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Validation.ActionIs.md): Validates that the action is the specified action.
  - [Ash.Resource.Validation.AttributeIn](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Validation.AttributeIn.md): Deprecated. Use `Ash.Resource.Validation.OneOf` via `one_of/2` in `Ash.Resource.Validation.Builtins`.
  - [Ash.Resource.Validation.Context](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Validation.Context.md): Context for a validation.

  - [Ash.Resource.Validation.PreFlightAuthorization](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Validation.PreFlightAuthorization.md): Validates that the action is being run in a pre-flight authorization context (i.e. `Ash.can?/3`).

- Tracing
  - [Ash.Tracer](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Tracer.md): A behaviour for implementing tracing for an Ash application.

  - [Ash.Tracer.Simple](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Tracer.Simple.md): A simple tracer that can send traces to the current process or call a module with the trace.

  - [Ash.Tracer.Simple.Span](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Tracer.Simple.Span.md): A span produced by `Ash.Tracer.Simple`

- Utilities
  - [Ash.BulkResult](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.BulkResult.md): The return value for bulk actions.

  - [Ash.Changeset.ManagedRelationshipHelpers](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Changeset.ManagedRelationshipHelpers.md): Tools for introspecting managed relationships.
  - [Ash.CiString](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.CiString.md): Represents a case insensitive string
  - [Ash.Expr](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Expr.md): Tools to build Ash expressions
  - [Ash.Filter](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Filter.md): The representation of a filter in Ash.
  - [Ash.Filter.Runtime](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Filter.Runtime.md): Tools to checks a record to see if it matches a filter statement, or to
evaluate expressions against records.

  - [Ash.Filter.Simple](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Filter.Simple.md): Represents a simplified filter, with a simple list of predicates
  - [Ash.Filter.Simple.Not](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Filter.Simple.Not.md): A negated predicate
  - [Ash.ForbiddenField](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.ForbiddenField.md): Represents a field that was hidden due to authorization rules.
  - [Ash.Mix.Tasks.Helpers](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Mix.Tasks.Helpers.md): Helpers for Ash Mix tasks.

  - [Ash.NotLoaded](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.NotLoaded.md): Used when a field hasn't been loaded or selected.
  - [Ash.OptionsHelpers](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.OptionsHelpers.md): Helpers for working with nimble options

  - [Ash.Page](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Page.md): Types for Ash pages
  - [Ash.Page.Keyset](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Page.Keyset.md): A page of results from `keyset` based pagination.
  - [Ash.Page.Offset](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Page.Offset.md): A page of results from `offset` based pagination.
  - [Ash.PlugHelpers](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.PlugHelpers.md): Helpers for working with the Plug connection.

  - [Ash.ProcessHelpers](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.ProcessHelpers.md): Helpers for working with processes and Ash actions.

  - [Ash.Resource.Builder](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Resource.Builder.md): Tools for transforming resources in DSL Transformers.

  - [Ash.SatSolver](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.SatSolver.md)
  - [Ash.Sort](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Sort.md): Utilities and types for sorting.

  - [Ash.UUID](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.UUID.md): Helpers for working with UUIDs
  - [Ash.UUIDv7](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.UUIDv7.md): Helpers for working with UUIDs version 7.
  - [Ash.Union](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Union.md): A wrapper for values that are sourced from `Ash.Type.Union`.

  - [Ash.Vector](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Vector.md): A vector struct for Ash.

- Types
  - [Ash.Type](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.md): The `Ash.Type` behaviour is used to define a value type in Ash.
  - [Ash.Type.Atom](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Atom.md): Stores an atom as a string in the database
  - [Ash.Type.Binary](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Binary.md): Represents a binary.
  - [Ash.Type.Boolean](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Boolean.md): Represents a boolean.
  - [Ash.Type.CiString](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.CiString.md): Stores a case insensitive string in the database
  - [Ash.Type.Comparable](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Comparable.md): Helpers for working with `Comparable`
  - [Ash.Type.CompositeTypeHelpers](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.CompositeTypeHelpers.md): Shared utilities for composite type validation and error handling.
  - [Ash.Type.Date](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Date.md): Represents a date in the database
  - [Ash.Type.DateTime](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.DateTime.md): Represents a datetime, with configurable precision and timezone.
  - [Ash.Type.Decimal](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Decimal.md): Represents a decimal.
  - [Ash.Type.Duration](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Duration.md): Represents a Duration
  - [Ash.Type.DurationName](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.DurationName.md): An interval of time, primarily meant to be used in expression functions
  - [Ash.Type.Enum](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Enum.md): A type for abstracting enums into a single type.
  - [Ash.Type.File](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.File.md): A type that represents a file on the filesystem.
  - [Ash.Type.File.Implementation](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.File.Implementation.md): Behaviour for file implementations that are compatible with `Ash.Type.File`.

  - [Ash.Type.File.Source](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.File.Source.md): Protocol for allowing the casting of something into an `Ash.Type.File`.
  - [Ash.Type.Float](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Float.md): Represents a float (floating point number)
  - [Ash.Type.Function](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Function.md): Represents a function.
  - [Ash.Type.Integer](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Integer.md): Represents a simple integer
  - [Ash.Type.Keyword](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Keyword.md): Represents a keyword list, stored as a `:map` in the database.
  - [Ash.Type.Map](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Map.md): Represents a map stored in the database.
  - [Ash.Type.Module](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Module.md): Stores a module as a string in the database.
  - [Ash.Type.NaiveDatetime](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.NaiveDatetime.md): Represents a Naive datetime
  - [Ash.Type.NewType](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.NewType.md): Allows defining a new type that is the combination of an existing type and custom constraints
  - [Ash.Type.String](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.String.md): Stores a string in the database.
  - [Ash.Type.Struct](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Struct.md): Represents a struct.
  - [Ash.Type.Term](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Term.md): Represents a raw elixir term in the database
  - [Ash.Type.Time](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Time.md): Represents a time in the database, with a 'second' precision
  - [Ash.Type.TimeUsec](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.TimeUsec.md): Represents a time with `microsecond` precision.
  - [Ash.Type.Tuple](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Tuple.md): Represents a tuple stored in the data layer as a map.
  - [Ash.Type.UUID](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.UUID.md): Represents a UUID.
  - [Ash.Type.UUIDv7](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.UUIDv7.md): Represents a UUID.
  - [Ash.Type.Union](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Union.md): A union between multiple types, distinguished with a tag or by attempting to validate.
  - [Ash.Type.UrlEncodedBinary](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.UrlEncodedBinary.md): Represents a binary that attempts to decode input strings as a url encoded base64 string.
  - [Ash.Type.UtcDatetime](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.UtcDatetime.md): Represents a utc datetime, with 'second' precision. A wrapper around `:datetime` for backwards compatibility.
  - [Ash.Type.UtcDatetimeUsec](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.UtcDatetimeUsec.md): Represents a utc datetime with `microsecond` precision. A wrapper around `:datetime` for backwards compatibility.
  - [Ash.Type.Vector](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Type.Vector.md): Represents a vector.

- Errors
  - [Ash.Error](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Error.md): Tools and utilities used by Ash to manage and conform errors

  - [Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument.md): Used when an invalid value is provided for an action argument
  - [Ash.Error.Changes.ActionRequiresActor](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Error.Changes.ActionRequiresActor.md): Used when an actor is referenced in a filter template, but no actor exists
  - [Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidArgument](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidArgument.md): Used when an invalid value is provided for an action argument
  - [Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidAttribute](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidAttribute.md): Used when an invalid value is provided for an attribute change
  - [Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidChanges](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidChanges.md): Used when a change is provided that covers multiple attributes/relationships
  - [Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidRelationship](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidRelationship.md): Used when an invalid value is provided for a relationship change

## Mix Tasks

- Other
  - [mix ash](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.md): Prints Ash tasks and their information.
  - [mix ash.codegen](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Codegen.md): Runs all codegen tasks for any extension on any resource/domain in your application.
  - [mix ash.extend](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Extend.md): Adds an extension or extensions to the domain/resource
  - [mix ash.gen.base_resource](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Gen.BaseResource.md): Generates a base resource
  - [mix ash.gen.change](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Gen.Change.md): Generates a custom change
  - [mix ash.gen.custom_expression](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Gen.CustomExpression.md): Generates a custom expression
  - [mix ash.gen.domain](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Gen.Domain.md): Generates an Ash.Domain
  - [mix ash.gen.enum](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Gen.Enum.md): Generates an Ash.Type.Enum
  - [mix ash.gen.gettext](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Gen.Gettext.md): Copies Ash's `.pot` file into your application's `priv/gettext/` directory.
  - [mix ash.gen.preparation](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Gen.Preparation.md): Generates a custom preparation
  - [mix ash.gen.resource](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Gen.Resource.md): Generate and configure an Ash.Resource.
  - [mix ash.gen.validation](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Gen.Validation.md): Generates a custom validation
  - [mix ash.generate_livebook](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.GenerateLivebook.md): Generates a Livebook for each Ash domain.
  - [mix ash.generate_policy_charts](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.GeneratePolicyCharts.md): Generates a Mermaid Flow Chart for a given resource's policies.
  - [mix ash.generate_resource_diagrams](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.GenerateResourceDiagrams.md): Generates a Mermaid Resource Diagram for each Ash domain.
  - [mix ash.gettext.extract](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Gettext.Extract.md): Extracts translatable error messages from Ash source files and generates
a `.pot` (Portable Object Template) file.
  - [mix ash.install](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Install.md): Installs Ash into a project. Should be called with `mix igniter.install ash`
  - [mix ash.manifest.dump](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Manifest.Dump.md): Generates a JSON manifest of the application's public Ash surface
(resources, types, and action entrypoints).
  - [mix ash.migrate](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Migrate.md): Runs all migration tasks for any extension on any resource/domain in your application.

  - [mix ash.patch.extend](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Patch.Extend.md): Adds an extension or extensions to the domain/resource. Use `ash.extend` instead.

  - [mix ash.reset](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Reset.md): Runs all tear down tasks for any extension on any resource/domain in your application, followed by setup tasks.

  - [mix ash.rollback](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Rollback.md): Runs all rollback tasks for any extension on any resource/domain in your application.

  - [mix ash.setup](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Setup.md): Runs all setup tasks for any extension on any resource/domain in your application.
  - [mix ash.tear_down](https://ash.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.TearDown.md): Runs all tear down tasks for any extension on any resource/domain in your application.
